## Change and rationale

Describe the focused change and any migration/compatibility impact.

## Verification

- [ ] JVM tests and debug assembly
- [ ] Relevant device/controller/keyboard checks (or explain why unavailable)
- [ ] Lint/instrumented outcomes stated honestly, including tooling failures
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated where appropriate
- [ ] New dependencies/artwork include source and license/permission information
- [ ] No credentials, signing files, games or personal data included

For UI changes, include redacted screenshots. Do not publish vulnerability details in a PR.
